description: A white interlocking block structure sits on a blue bedspread in front of a pink pillow, with a few loose white blocks nearby. The left hand stays planted on the main structure to steady it as the right hand reaches in from the right, pinches a small rectangular block from the bed, brings it toward a side slot on the structure to test-fit it, then pulls it back away and holds it off to the right; throughout, the structure remains a left-hand object and the loose block is a right-hand object.
